svg.title: Each event is applied exactly once
svg.desc: A worker takes a webhook event from the log, runs the adapter and appends the observations to the log as a new event. It then takes that event and, in one transaction, checks the processed-ID table, writes facts and audit records and marks the ID done before committing its offset.
svg.text: A crash before COMMIT means redelivery, and the processed-ID check turns it into a no-op.
Runs only for a new observation
